# Repository steward instructions

Read [docs/REPOSITORY_STEWARDSHIP.md](docs/REPOSITORY_STEWARDSHIP.md) and
[BRANCHES.md](BRANCHES.md) before planning or creating branches. The generated
ORGANVM block above stays intact; these authored instructions survive regeneration.

This repository prefers completion over cleanup-by-deletion. Verify → Heal →
Expand → Evolve. Do not expand or evolve on a red or dishonest default branch.
Recover every living intention; finish it or park it with evidence. Default outcome
is green and merged unless unsafe, contradictory to purpose, technically false,
or an exact completed duplicate with no unique residue.

- Inventory all branches, open PRs/issues, recoverable closed-unmerged work,
  reviews, hidden work and default CI before mutations. Paginate; report unknown
  access surfaces. Recover purpose from source, commits and discussion.
- Read BRANCHES.md. Use one worktree per short-lived work branch, PRs to its
  proper lane or main, and one intention or amalgamated family per PR. Never add
  develop automatically, directly push protected branches, or rewrite default
  history. Standing lanes persist; park blocked work with its next step.
- Two same-root-cause siblings form a family. Recover each member's unique
  residue; use one successor issue and branch, link `amalgamated-into:#N`, and
  solve the class. Do not close siblings until the successor is verified on
  default and every member is accounted for.
- Deliver purpose/done/green in ≤10 lines, complete inventories A–D, unique/family
  verdict cards, branch constitution, ordered waves with proof, actions performed,
  and illogical items preserved with evidence. Execute authorized work after the
  plan exists; avoid another approval loop for already authorized actions.
- Wave order: default/security/integrity failures; nearly mergeable PRs; unique
  branch work; issues unblocking them; stated expansion; evolution; optional work.
  Each queue item includes evidence, tests, merge target, and member dispositions.
- Comment on every touched issue/PR with recovered intention, verdict, next step,
  and links. Link implementation via `Refs #N`; native closing keywords in PR
  titles/bodies/commits bypass post-merge proof and are rejected by the policy guard.
- Closure requires a preceding comment stating intention, exact-default evidence,
  successor artifact, and why no unique work is lost. Merge alone is insufficient.
  Do not delete for tidiness or age. Retire lanes only through a documented PR.
- Green means applicable required checks and purpose invariants pass at the exact
  delivered commit. Preserve historical evidence versus contemporary execution,
  original versus generated sources, and artist approval versus engineering proof.
- Keep secrets, credentials and production data out of git. Scope work to this
  repository except documented dependencies needed for its green state. Do not
  weaken tests or add unrelated refactors to make a change appear complete.

Known purpose: a-mavs-olevm is the evolved ETCETER4 exhibition of music, images,
words, manuscripts and interactive editions. The original historical website has
its own preservation/restoration repository. Preserve work identities, original
credits, source lineage and earlier editions; a completed edition does not end a
work's future evolution. Album remasters, remixes, new vocal performances, visual
interpretations, original multitracks and separated stems remain distinct. Artist
public text and checked transcriptions require actual authored/recovered material.
